notes: `upstream` is the base image the extended Dockerfile FROMs — the Isol8 fork (Isol8AI/agent) built from upstream OpenClaw 2026.7.1-beta.3 plus the three carried fork patches (bundled-MCP non-blocking materialization + shared-runtime-scope, and provider-agnostic size-based context pruning — Isol8AI/agent#1) AND the bundled native `meta` provider (extensions/meta, muse-spark-1.1; cherry-picked from upstream/main #102873/#103070/#103163 since it landed after beta.3 was cut — not pruned, ships in the base). REQUIRED to build the extended image FROM this fork tag, NOT vanilla ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw: config.py emits mcp.runtimeScope="shared" which only the shared-runtime-scope patch adds to the strict config schema — a vanilla 7.1 base crash-loops every MCP owner and (via 7.1's new fail-closed startup-migration checkpoint) fails the whole fleet closed. The 6.6-era WAL-on-NFS patch was dropped as 6.10+ supersedes it natively; tag scheme `<upstream-version>-isol8.<n>`. This is a PRIVATE GHCR package, only pulled by the authenticated build-openclaw-image.yml workflow. `image`/`tag`/`full` are the LEGACY PUBLIC upstream image (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw): container-stack.ts uses `full` as the bootstrap/unknown-env fallback, pulled by per-user ECS tasks that carry NO registry credentials — so it must stay anonymously pullable and must NOT point at the private fork. `tag` also feeds the OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_VERSION env-var fallback; keep it at the upstream version currently deployed (the `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` extended images, which drive meta.lastTouchedVersion, are the authoritative deployed baseline). `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev and prod (re-stamped by build-openclaw-image.yml on each base/extended build).
